comparison.objective: Free a stuck print-in-place hinge by rocking it.
comparison.physical_skill: Grip the printed assembly and apply alternating angular motion to overcome fused or high-friction hinge contact without breaking the part.
comparison.success_condition: The hinge must attain the required free range of motion while the surrounding print remains intact and undamaged.
comparison.reason: Rocking to free an intact articulation tests cyclic breakaway motion. It neither uses a stabilized impact mandrel nor requires intended part fracture and containment of separated fragments.
